caption:
OG Glazed Donut Dough 

Part I of the donuts starts with making the best dough you will need to make these donuts. this takes less than 10 minutes to come together and another hour to rise before you can move on with the rolling, shaping and frying :) 

This recipe makes 4-5 donuts with 10-12 donut holes :) 

Ingredients: 
- 120 ml milk, luke warm
- 30 grams caster sugar
- 1/2 tbsp dry active yeast
- 1 egg, room tempreture
- 1/2 tsp vanilla essense
- pinch, ground nutmeg
- pinch, salt
- 40 grams butter, if using unsalted omit the pinch of salt above
- 220 - 250 grams Maida

Method: 
As shown in the recipe :)
